related.title: TOPCon 與異質接面高效電池
related.titleEn: TOPCon and Heterojunction High-Efficiency Solar Cells
related.transfer: 可遷移「能隙與截止波長」與「衰退率與 T80 壽命」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；TOPCon 與異質接面高效電池的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Bandgap and cut-off wavelength" and "Degradation rate and T80 life" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of TOPCon and Heterojunction High-Efficiency Solar Cells must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦在矽上面再疊一層電池：能隙與波長、熱化損失、電流匹配、壽命與含鉛量；TOPCon 與異質接面高效電池則以把矽電池推向理論極限的兩條路：鈍化接觸與開路電壓、銀耗量、雙面率與極限差距為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on stacking another cell on silicon: bandgap and wavelength, thermalisation loss, current matching, lifetime and lead content; TOPCon and Heterojunction High-Efficiency Solar Cells centres on two routes pushing silicon cells toward the theoretical limit: passivating contacts and open-circuit voltage, silver use, bifaciality and the gap to the limit, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「電池溫度與功率損失」的模型移到TOPCon 與異質接面高效電池，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「雙面率的差異」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "Cell temperature and power loss" to TOPCon and Heterojunction High-Efficiency Solar Cells, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Difference in bifaciality", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「能隙與截止波長」與「衰退率與 T80 壽命」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；TOPCon 與異質接面高效電池的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Bandgap and cut-off wavelength" and "Degradation rate and T80 life" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of TOPCon and Heterojunction High-Efficiency Solar Cells must be respecified.

related.title: 太陽能模組封裝與耐候測試
related.titleEn: Photovoltaic Module Encapsulation and Weathering Tests
related.transfer: 可遷移「能隙與截止波長」與「衰退率與 T80 壽命」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；太陽能模組封裝與耐候測試的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Bandgap and cut-off wavelength" and "Degradation rate and T80 life" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Photovoltaic Module Encapsulation and Weathering Tests must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦在矽上面再疊一層電池：能隙與波長、熱化損失、電流匹配、壽命與含鉛量；太陽能模組封裝與耐候測試則以用幾個月的試驗預測二十五年：濕熱的加速因子、熱循環的伸縮差、機械載重、冰雹與紫外線為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on stacking another cell on silicon: bandgap and wavelength, thermalisation loss, current matching, lifetime and lead content; Photovoltaic Module Encapsulation and Weathering Tests centres on predicting twenty-five years from months of testing: damp-heat acceleration, thermal-cycling mismatch, mechanical load, hail and ultraviolet, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「電池溫度與功率損失」的模型移到太陽能模組封裝與耐候測試，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「冰雹的撞擊能量」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "Cell temperature and power loss" to Photovoltaic Module Encapsulation and Weathering Tests, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Impact energy of hail", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「能隙與截止波長」與「衰退率與 T80 壽命」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；太陽能模組封裝與耐候測試的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Bandgap and cut-off wavelength" and "Degradation rate and T80 life" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Photovoltaic Module Encapsulation and Weathering Tests must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鈣鈦礦／矽疊層太陽電池
history.text: 2009 年鈣鈦礦首次被用於太陽電池；2018 年疊層電池效率超過矽單接面的紀錄；2023 年實驗室效率達到 33.9%；2024 年商用疊層模組開始出貨。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2009: Perovskite was first used in a solar cell. 2018: Tandem efficiency passed the silicon single-junction record. 2023: Laboratory efficiency reached 33.9%. 2024: Commercial tandem modules began shipping. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
